name: card-hover
title: Card Hover
description: Grid of linked title-and-description cards with a rounded highlight panel that follows the pointer.

meta.interaction: Hovering a card fades a soft rounded block in behind it and outlines its border; moving to another card glides that block across to the new one rather than making it reappear.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; description: string; link: string; }[]
